<div  id="container--text-padding"  class='flex_column av-o2is-08751dd694a1bceaf7849f3379c2db92 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-1  el_after_av_section  el_before_av_section  avia-builder-el-no-sibling  first flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-kveg2frd-507a0e5dde8b6f3ad868a83aea895df5 av-special-heading-h1 blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-2  el_before_av_textblock  avia-builder-el-first '><h1 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Welcome to Logos Beach Village!</h1><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kveg2md2-952759d875032879413776c4d7b31fd6 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p style="text-align: center;">Are you a water sports enthusiast or do you just love vacationing by the sea and are looking for an exceptional and comfortable accommodation right on the beach? Then LOGOS Beach Village is the right place for you!</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Boutique style &#8220;Glamping&#8221; is waiting for you directly by the sea. A new, comfortable kite/surf accommodation with a total of only 13 XL and XXL lodges as well as 4 studios with a fantastic view of the kite spot, a pool on the terrace, a beach bar and many other features. Due to their perfect location, spread over an approximately 10,000 square meter property directly on the beach, the lodges grant a lot of privacy.</p>
</div></section></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id='av_section_2'  class='avia-section av-kveg4rsz-1450942df07471cffb60bb555c7b4cc8 alternate_color avia-section-default avia-no-border-styling  avia-builder-el-4  el_after_av_one_full  el_before_av_one_third  svg-separator av-parallax-section avia-bg-style-parallax av-minimum-height av-minimum-height-50 av-height-50  container_wrap fullsize'  data-section-bg-repeat='no-repeat' data-av_minimum_height_pc='50' data-av_min_height_opt='50'><div class='av-parallax' data-avia-parallax-ratio='0.3' ><div class='av-parallax-inner alternate_color avia-full-stretch'></div></div><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content  av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-1172'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'>
<div  class='flex_column av-kveg75kt-c8bef5a626524929b26f9e9b29310b80 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-5  avia-builder-el-no-sibling  first flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='av-special-heading av-kveg623h-a976061bb5a77bc87f73d2cd6680407f av-special-heading-h2 blockquote modern-quote modern-centered  avia-builder-el-6  avia-builder-el-no-sibling '><h2 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >From bed to board</h2><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div></div>

<div  class='flex_column av-2udys-a7d11eca351f87c381cfc7daf064abe3 av_one_third  avia-builder-el-7  el_after_av_section  el_before_av_one_third  avia-builder-el-first  first flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='avia-image-container av-kvfbwxq8-133599ce91f227aeaad92ffbae7ace7f av-styling- avia-align-center  avia-builder-el-8  el_before_av_heading  avia-builder-el-first '   itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><div class="avia-image-container-inner"><div class="avia-image-overlay-wrap"><img decoding="async" fetchpriority="high" class='wp-image-1042 avia-img-lazy-loading-not-1042 avia_image ' src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-vom-bett-aufs-brett.jpg" alt='' title=''  height="322" width="500"  itemprop="thumbnailUrl" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-vom-bett-aufs-brett.jpg 500w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-vom-bett-aufs-brett-300x193.jpg 300w" sizes="(max-width: 500px) 100vw, 500px" /></div></div></div>
<div  class='av-special-heading av-kvfbx8k9-b7964d6b230bb0195e761f15aebd4f25 av-special-heading-h5 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-9  el_after_av_image  el_before_av_textblock '><h5 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >From bed to board</h5><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvfbxyod-bad9cedff9a9f7f82f3754de6a67dc41 '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Isn&#8217;t it dreamy to hear the sound of the sea from your own veranda after waking up, to smell the salt in the air while watching the shining kites and sails on the water? Off to the board!</p>
</div></section></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-1wfig-1ebbd77a90b6d8381a44db5465859166 av_one_third  avia-builder-el-11  el_after_av_one_third  el_before_av_one_third  flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='avia-image-container av-kvfby5yp-1d9b56f558361babac38a5cccfc2d5ae av-styling- avia-align-center  avia-builder-el-12  el_before_av_heading  avia-builder-el-first '   itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><div class="avia-image-container-inner"><div class="avia-image-overlay-wrap"><img decoding="async" class='wp-image-1040 avia-img-lazy-loading-not-1040 avia_image ' src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-fruehstueck-am-strand.jpg" alt='' title=''  height="322" width="500"  itemprop="thumbnailUrl" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-fruehstueck-am-strand.jpg 500w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-fruehstueck-am-strand-300x193.jpg 300w" sizes="(max-width: 500px) 100vw, 500px" /></div></div></div>
<div  class='av-special-heading av-kvfbyed0-bc4c8d55480bf437fc05b049d55e9b50 av-special-heading-h5 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-13  el_after_av_image  el_before_av_textblock '><h5 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Breakfast is better at the Beach</h5><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvfbysxy-b144fb945065d97b6d8c1a5b35889dfc '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Start the day with a creamy cappuccino and treats from our breakfast buffet, which is included for our Beach Village guests. Breakfast is served on our terraces or on your private veranda and then we head straight to the spot, full of energy.</p>
</div></section></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-1c6nk-b44a8ab7f9cd4edb7a6303d7701bc84b av_one_third  avia-builder-el-15  el_after_av_one_third  el_before_av_one_full  flex_column_div  '     ><div  class='avia-image-container av-11drk-1eb97f6e0f7bb1760d8fc6b8419219e3 av-styling- avia-align-center  avia-builder-el-16  el_before_av_heading  avia-builder-el-first '   itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><div class="avia-image-container-inner"><div class="avia-image-overlay-wrap"><img decoding="async" class='wp-image-1133 avia-img-lazy-loading-not-1133 avia_image ' src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-surf-and-kite-theologos-2022.jpg" alt='' title=''  height="322" width="500"  itemprop="thumbnailUrl" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-surf-and-kite-theologos-2022.jpg 500w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/logos-beach-village-surf-and-kite-theologos-2022-300x193.jpg 300w" sizes="(max-width: 500px) 100vw, 500px" /></div></div></div>
<div  class='av-special-heading av-kvfbyzxy-52121d8c2e13598e1271e03ee5f9d062 av-special-heading-h5 blockquote modern-quote  avia-builder-el-17  el_after_av_image  el_before_av_textblock '><h5 class='av-special-heading-tag '  itemprop="headline"  >Surf <span class='special_amp'>&amp;</span> Kite Theologos</h5><div class="special-heading-border"><div class="special-heading-inner-border"></div></div></div>
<section  class='av_textblock_section av-kvfbzc4k-e4e1038094240ba3b7265d2fb8bb9bbf '   itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock'  itemprop="text" ><p>Welcome to Theologos! Our professional kitesurfing and windsurfing center offers constant wind, a professional team, brand new equipment and VDWS certified trainings as well as a lot of sport flair at one of the best watersport destinations in Europe.</p>
</div></section></div>
<div  class='flex_column av-kvfcd9gc-3af63d987659732592afd3eb83cce9f0 av_one_full  avia-builder-el-19  el_after_av_one_third  el_before_av_heading  first flex_column_div  column-top-margin'     ><div  class='avia-testimonial-wrapper av-kvfc52pn-b81d1fd1542d2b2f25b7e1298b552c05 avia-slider-testimonials avia-slider-2-testimonials avia_animate_when_almost_visible av-large-testimonial-slider av-slideshow-ui av-control-default av-slider-hover-pause av-slideshow-autoplay av-loop-endless av-loop-manual-endless' data-slideshow-options="{&quot;animation&quot;:&quot;fade&quot;,&quot;autoplay&quot;:true,&quot;loop_autoplay&quot;:&quot;endless&quot;,&quot;interval&quot;:15,&quot;loop_manual&quot;:&quot;manual-endless&quot;,&quot;autoplay_stopper&quot;:false,&quot;noNavigation&quot;:false,&quot;bg_slider&quot;:false,&quot;keep_padding&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;hoverpause&quot;:true,&quot;show_slide_delay&quot;:0}">
<section class="avia-testimonial-row"><div class='avia-testimonial av-kvfc4r9j-e2d4af26223bffd0de0aa2d8a7165e7e avia-testimonial-row-1 avia-first-testimonial flex_column no_margin av_one_half'><div class='avia-testimonial_inner'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia-testimonial-content '><div class='avia-testimonial-markup-entry-content'  itemprop="text" ><p>Theologos is not only an optimal destination for us with a child, but also the kite spot is perfect. Once we&#8217;re there, the clock is ticking in vacation mode. The people, the togetherness at the spot, the wind yield, the food, the team of Surf and Kite Theologos are just terrific. We travel there every year and are looking forward to staying at the new Beach Village in 2018. #welovekiting@surfandkitetheologos</p>
</div></div><div class="avia-testimonial-meta"><div class="avia-testimonial-arrow-wrap"><div class="avia-arrow"></div></div><div class='avia-testimonial-image'  itemprop="image" ><img decoding="async" width="180" height="180" src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/mona-daniel-louis-logos-beach-village-180x180.png" class="attachment-square size-square" alt="" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/mona-daniel-louis-logos-beach-village-180x180.png 180w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/mona-daniel-louis-logos-beach-village.png 300w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/mona-daniel-louis-logos-beach-village-80x80.png 80w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/mona-daniel-louis-logos-beach-village-36x36.png 36w" sizes="(max-width: 180px) 100vw, 180px" /></div><div class='avia-testimonial-meta-mini'  itemprop="author" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/Person" ><strong  class='avia-testimonial-name'  itemprop="name" >Mona &amp; Daniel + Louis</strong><span  class='avia-testimonial-subtitle '  itemprop="jobTitle" > from cologne</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class='avia-testimonial av-kvfc4r9j-3-729f51ac7bb2cecfb62cd1c60a83d9ab avia-testimonial-row-1 flex_column no_margin av_one_half'><div class='avia-testimonial_inner'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia-testimonial-content '><div class='avia-testimonial-markup-entry-content'  itemprop="text" ><p>The kite spot and the location of the luxury lodges are simply unsurpassable. The equipment is high quality, cool style- we had plenty of space in the tent and a super comfortable temperature. The fact that you can stay right on the beach with a view of the water and enjoy the sunset together on the terrace is priceless. Our little daughter had a lot of fun in the two pools. The breakfast is great and the service is great!</p>
</div></div><div class="avia-testimonial-meta"><div class="avia-testimonial-arrow-wrap"><div class="avia-arrow"></div></div><div class='avia-testimonial-image'  itemprop="image" ><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="180" height="180" src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/daniel-nina-logos-beach-village-180x180.png" class="attachment-square size-square" alt="" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/daniel-nina-logos-beach-village-180x180.png 180w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/daniel-nina-logos-beach-village.png 300w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/daniel-nina-logos-beach-village-80x80.png 80w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/daniel-nina-logos-beach-village-36x36.png 36w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 180px) 100vw, 180px" /></div><div class='avia-testimonial-meta-mini'  itemprop="author" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/Person" ><strong  class='avia-testimonial-name'  itemprop="name" >Daniel &amp; Nina</strong><span  class='avia-testimonial-subtitle '  itemprop="jobTitle" >from Hagen</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class='avia-testimonial av-kvfc4r9j-2-eb298b08326e30088bc5653e84c0f901 avia-testimonial-row-1 flex_column no_margin av_one_half'><div class='avia-testimonial_inner'  itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia-testimonial-content '><div class='avia-testimonial-markup-entry-content'  itemprop="text" ><p>As I saw the plans this year, we were quickly enthusiastic about the concept. Not a hotel bunker, more like a park with interesting quarters. All the questions were already thought out and the answers increased my interest. Really looking forward to 2018 to see the reality and live in it.</p>
</div></div><div class="avia-testimonial-meta"><div class="avia-testimonial-arrow-wrap"><div class="avia-arrow"></div></div><div class='avia-testimonial-image'  itemprop="image" ><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="180" height="180" src="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/familie-syboeck-logos-beach-village-180x180.png" class="attachment-square size-square" alt="" srcset="https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/familie-syboeck-logos-beach-village-180x180.png 180w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/familie-syboeck-logos-beach-village.png 300w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/familie-syboeck-logos-beach-village-80x80.png 80w, https://www.logosbeachvillage.com/wp-content/uploads/familie-syboeck-logos-beach-village-36x36.png 36w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 180px) 100vw, 180px" /></div><div class='avia-testimonial-meta-mini'  itemprop="author" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/Person" ><strong  class='avia-testimonial-name'  itemprop="name" >Syböck family</strong><span  class='avia-testimonial-subtitle '  itemprop="jobTitle" >from Vienna</span></div></div></div></div>
</section><div class='avia-slideshow-arrows avia-slideshow-controls' ><a href='#prev' class='prev-slide  avia-svg-icon avia-font-svg_entypo-fontello' data-av_svg_icon='left-open-big' data-av_iconset='svg_entypo-fontello' tabindex='-1' title="Previous"><svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="15" height="32" viewBox="0 0 15 32" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" aria-labelledby='av-svg-title-1' aria-describedby='av-svg-desc-1' role="graphics-symbol" aria-hidden="true"></svg><span class='avia_hidden_link_text'>Previous</span></a><a href='#next' class='next-slide  avia-svg-icon avia-font-svg_entypo-fontello' data-av_svg_icon='right-open-big' data-av_iconset='svg_entypo-fontello' tabindex='-1' title="Next"><svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="15" height="32" viewBox="0 0 15 32" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" aria-labelledby='av-svg-title-2' aria-describedby='av-svg-desc-2' role="graphics-symbol" aria-hidden="true"></svg><span class='avia_hidden_link_text'>Next</span></a></div></div></div>
